programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: The Orkney Islands lie just off the North Coast of Scotland. The 70 islands are surrounded by the Atlantic and the North Sea. The landscape is made up of lush hills; steep cliffs arise in the south. Only 21,000 people live here, but there are plenty more sheep and cattle.

programme.title: The Design Tourist
programme.desc: The Design Tourist travels to Frankfurt, Germany, the European financial capital, and a global host of trade shows. Explore the city's complicated history and fascinating culture through its legacy shaped war and commerce.

programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Painting The Town
programme.desc: Folk artist Eric Dowdle travels across North America, meeting the local people, sampling food, learning about culture and touring local attractions in an effort to determine what makes each place unique. Each episode culminates in the creation of a piece of colorful folk art that symbolizes the place Dowdle has visited.

programme.title: World Tour
programme.desc: In the thrilling travel show “World Tour,” viewers embark on captivating adventures to the most exotic corners of the planet. From the charming streets of Paris to the breathtaking landscapes of New Zealand, each episode offers new amazing places, cultures, and traditions. With inspiring stories from locals and unexpected discoveries, “World Tour” immerses viewers in the exciting world of travel and adventure.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave and Kari visit the beautiful city of San Diego, California. They check out Old Town, Balboa Park, The San Diego Mission, and the famous Del Coronado Hotel.

programme.title: Great Family Adventure
programme.desc: Pro kayakers Nick Troutman & Emily Jackson and family tour the attractions and adventures of Ocean City, Maryland

programme.title: Adventure Cities
programme.desc: Seasoned travel writer Jonathan Thompson sets out to explore the adventurous sides of Dallas, Texas and Pensacola, Florida

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick travel to Gettysburg, PA and experience the battlefield from behind enemy lines. They step back in time and explore the many places that make this town a must stop in Pennsylvania.

programme.title: Exotic Destinations 101

programme.title: Rustic Adventures: Argentina
programme.desc: A hybrid food, travel and adventure show, Season 1 of Rustic Adventures followed two young, hot chefs who fulfilled their lifelong dream of building their own successful restaurants – from scratch – as they decide to take a much needed break and seek out inspiration for new endeavors while on a rustic food tour across Italy. Following Season 1’s adventures in Italy, the rustic adventures continue for young chef/owners Rob Rossi and Craig Harding as they head for the towering mountain ranges and rugged countryside of Argentina. From the Pampas to the peaks of the Andes they’ll find endless inspiration in this South American hotspot.

programme.title: Todo Bien
programme.sub-title: A Week Alone on Remote Beaches
programme.desc: Baja holds an almost mystical reputation in the overland community. They also sprinkle in tips for traveling in Baja to help anyone curious about travel south of the border.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!
